result: The bounded, conditional F082 current-source relationship is supported, with the readback and downstream assertions qualified below. This is source review, not product validation or a new unique defect count.

reviewed_working_evidence.qualification: At observation these coordinator materials were untracked working files; their identity is distinct from source revision and from the publication repository committed HEAD. All 28 packet members matched their manifest, with no unlisted files at the time of copying. Draft-versus-final changed only six evidence paths and review_qualification; the draft accurately predates this separately recorded review.

observations.name: Public buffer and retained aggregate
observations.analysis: The three public buffers can be individually replaced while count, capacity and host inverse masses remain private; public buffer upload accepts element representations. The selected solver binds these buffers and dispatches the retained count. Supported callers, all native usage requirements, mutation, synchronization and native outcomes are not established.

observations.name: Short readback and whole-record guard
observations.analysis: For a replacement whose declared byte size is an integer number of records below the retained count, a successful native read and copy yields that smaller number of typed records; each selected particle reader takes at most the retained count without enforcing equality. A partial-record byte size is rejected, and the native read can fail. This is conditional source reasoning, not evidence a supported caller reaches or executes this scenario.

observations.name: Selected write safeguards and earlier assertion
observations.analysis: Normal write checks position/mass cardinality before upload, then updates count and host masses after the three shown uploads; write_positions restores the temporarily taken mass vector on normal return, including returned errors. The selected correction paths pack with the host mass vector and reject a mismatched pack before their writeback. However, OuterLayer::project first asserts the positions/velocities and positions/masses lengths: a successful short read reaching this call can panic at those earlier assertions before the pack safeguard. This is a current-source refinement of 774 ADDITIONAL-104, which already mentioned downstream assertions, not a new historical discovery. SurfaceContacts is not shown safe up to its pack on all mismatched states; its internal solver and native effects remain outside this review.
